set.body:
Goal: prevent a correct parser from becoming unusable on multi-hour high-rate recordings.

Acceptance criteria:
- Benchmarks cover representative 250/500/1000/2000 Hz durations, monocular/binocular layouts, message-rich streams, and pathological long-line cases.
- Parser-only peak memory is bounded by declared byte/line/chunk budgets, excluding chosen recording materialization.
- Throughput and allocation baselines are recorded on named hardware/JVM; PR smoke gates detect gross regressions and scheduled runs track tighter budgets.
- Byte budgets replace line-count or sample-count proxies for allocation preflight.
- Streaming and materialized workflows report their different memory envelopes.
- Cancellation and malformed-input stress do not leak file handles or retain unbounded source text.
- Performance claims and thresholds are stored in the validation result rather than implied by a passing unit suite.
set.title: Certify EyeLink streaming throughput and bounded memory
